d:
The US-Iran war has dragged on for nearly seven months, with strikes, ceasefires and negotiations failing to deliver a lasting resolution. Now, Iran has sent Washington a fresh proposal — but this time, Tehran has given the US just seven days to meet its conditions.
Iran wants a halt to hostilities, sanctions relief, the release of frozen assets and an end to the US naval blockade. In return, Tehran says it could reopen the Strait of Hormuz and restart talks on its nuclear programme.
